title: miQCadj: Basic workflow
text: Filtering cells using strict thresholds features, counts, mitochondrial percentages can remove specific cell types cell states. Therefore, conditional filtering taking complexity information (counts / features) mitochondrial percentages consideration prioritized. miQC provides convenient approach overcoming need specifying specific cutoffs complexity information mitochondrial percentages fitting two-component mixture model using flexmix. miQCadj provides implementation original miQC classification, extends workflow Featuring Seurat SummarizedExperiment workflows, Supporting median-based identification intact compromised model components spline, polynomial, polynomial-raw models, Enabling comparisons model classification, original geometry-based adjustments labeling compromised cell fractions transferring selected results back input objects.

what: Running miQCadj using a subset of pbmcsca
title: miQCadj: Basic workflow
text: vignette demonstrates functionality miQCadj package using two small example datasets derived pbmcsca dataset provided SeuratData package. included datasets represent peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) two samples processed different sequencing technologies: pbmc1_Smart-seq2 pbmc2_CEL-Seq2 subsets selected illustrate: geometry-based reassignment misclassified cells differences intercept- median-based component selection original dataset available via SeuratData package.

title: miQCadj: Basic workflow
text: pbmc_sub2 dataset contains 33694 genes 526 cells 253 cells pbmc1 generated Smartseq2 273 cells pbmc2 generated CELSeq2: meta.data already comprises information regarding features ("nFeature_RNA"), UMI counts ("nCount_RNA"), mitochondrial percentages ("percent.mt"). Additionally, cell type annotation available ("CellType"). Cell filtering performed per sample. Therefore, define sample, converting pbmc2 SummarizedExperiment-related object demonstration purposes:
code: library(miQCadj) suppressPackageStartupMessages({   library(Seurat)   library(SeuratObject)   library(SingleCellExperiment)   library(ggplot2)}) data("pbmc_sub2", package = "miQCadj") stats::addmargins(table(pbmc_sub2$sample_tech)) #>  #> pbmc1_Smartseq2   pbmc2_CELSeq2             Sum  #>             253             273             526 pbmc1 <- subset(pbmc_sub2, subset=sample_tech=="pbmc1_Smartseq2") pbmc2 <- subset(pbmc_sub2, subset=sample_tech=="pbmc2_CELSeq2") pbmc2 <- Seurat::as.SingleCellExperiment(pbmc2)

title: miQCadj: Basic workflow
text: Post-hoc adjustments essential minimizing model-induced classifications artifacts, favored filtering Single Cell Datasets. simple scenarios occur linear datasets, discard line crossed keep line causing removal high complexity, low mitochondrial reads. Running adjust_classifications() strongly reduce model-related filtering artifacts. provide original_check geometry_check, added flexmix data frame default: using adjust_classification(), original_check always keep cells intact cell distribution, argument enforce_left_cutoff can either TRUE, discard several cells low intermediate library complexity higher mitochondrial percentage, FALSE keep cells. region-related geometry_check performs curve- distance-based plausibility adjustments, hasn’t benchmarked far, therefore, represents experimental, heuristic adjustment method. visualized inspected using check_miQC_predictions(), selected applied. pbmc1_Smartseq2: Unmodified Adjusted Cell Predictions Though adjustment methods use distinct approaches reassigning cells, provide identical predictions sample given shared cells either labelled both_keep both_discard. diagnostics regarding specific adjustments made adjustment method corresponding regions, can visualized using: pbmc1_Smartseq2: Original Adjusted Cell Classification default, returned list plots combined using patchwork. return list plot separate accessible, set combine_plots=FALSE.

title: miQCadj: Basic workflow
text: pbmc2 sample uses Seurat-inherent column names percent.mt nFeature_RNA, instead standard naming conventions SummarizedExperiment- derived objects, subsets_mito_percent mitochondrial percentage information detected feature information. Therefore, column names need specified. default, original miQC package uses intercept component definition, can cause incorrect cell selection, polynomial spline models selected: Intercept component selection pbmc2_CELSeq2: miQC Classification Posterior Probabilities Cell low Quality Using intercept component selection sample make incorrect assignments, loosing high-quality cells, keeping low-quality cells. , can check median component selection (use_median_columns = TRUE) using: Median component selection pbmc2_CELSeq2: miQC Classification Posterior Probabilities Cell low Quality assignments using medians component selection mode match biological expectations low complexity, high mitochondrial percentage cells belonging compromised component. Therefore, set component_selection = "median", using default posterior threshold (posterior_cutoff=0.75): Afterwards, adjusted classification check predictions: Unmodified Adjusted Cell Predictions pbmc2_CELSeq2 Apparently, original geometry-based adjustment methods produced substantially different classifications CEL-Seq2 sample many cells retained geometry_check discarded original_check. can check exact counts using: strict filtering original check introduced enforce_left_cutoff=TRUE. Since removing 93 cells, corresponding cell fraction 34.1%, shouldn’t performed without checks, set enforce_left_cutoff=FALSE. keep left_cutoff information available, without forcing extensive filtering decisions without quality checks performed: Unmodified Adjusted Cell Predictions pbmc2_CELSeq2 (without left cutoff) Now, adjustment methods provide identical results, adjustments made, given shared cells either labelled both_keep both_discard. check regions assigned adjustment methods can create prediction plot adjustment methods: Median-based Component Selection Region-Adjustments pbmc2_CELSeq2 (without left cutoff)
code: fm2 <- run_miQCadj(input_obj = pbmc2, percent_mt = "percent.mt",                     complexity_column = "nFeature_RNA",                     model_type = "polynomial", add_median_selection = TRUE) check_miQC_components(flexmix_list = fm2,                        sample_name = "Intercept-based components for pbmc2_CELSeq2",                        combine_plots=TRUE) check_miQC_components(flexmix_list = fm2,                        sample_name = "Median-based components for pbmc2_CELSeq2",                        use_median_columns = TRUE) fm2 <-  define_classification(flexmix_list = fm2,                                component_selection = "median") fm2 <-  adjust_classification(flexmix_list = fm2)  # check predictions check_miQC_predictions(flexmix_list = fm2,  sample_name = "pbmc2_CELSeq2",                        add_unadjusted_prediction = TRUE,                         add_compared_prediction = TRUE,                        adjustment_method = NULL) addmargins(table(fm2$flexmix_data[["miQC.keep_adj_compared"]])) #>  #> both_discard    both_keep    keep_geom          Sum  #>           13          167           93          273 # adjust classification fm2 <-  adjust_classification(flexmix_list = fm2, enforce_left_cutoff = FALSE)  # check predictions check_miQC_predictions(flexmix_list = fm2, sample_name = "pbmc2_CELSeq2",                        add_unadjusted_prediction = TRUE,                         add_compared_prediction = TRUE,                        adjustment_method = NULL) check_miQC_predictions(fm2, sample_name = "pbmc2_CELSeq2")

title: Extensions and Utilities for miQC-based Cell Filtering
text: miQCadj provides extensions utilities miQC quality-control cell filtering Seurat SummarizedExperiment workflows. original miQC package uses two-component mixture model fitted flexmix model mitochondrial transcript percentage function cellular complexity identify potentially low-quality cells single-cell RNA-sequencing datasets. miQCadj extends workflow additional model specifications, configurable component selection, posterior-probability-based classification, post-hoc geometric validation. provides implementation original miQC classification adjustments alternative geometry-based approach, allowing users inspect compare adjusted cell classifications transferring selected results back input objects.
